caption: The drawing features a single, intricately designed lace garment, likely a jacket or bodice, depicted in black ink on a cream or light beige background. The lacework consists of various floral and geometric patterns, with dense circular and star-shaped motifs distributed symmetrically across the garment. The edges of the garment are scalloped, following the natural pattern of the lace, and the sleeves flare out with additional lace detail that ends in a decorative bow on each side. The collar is upright and also made of lace, featuring a fine, detailed edge. The drawing is rendered with high attention to detail, capturing the texture and delicate structure of the lace fabric. The artist’s signature, “FLORENCE EARL,” is visible in the lower right corner. There are no other objects or background elements present in the drawing.
title: Jacket
